title: Random Distribution of π
summary: Morellet's chance grid, but every square is decided by the next digit of π — the same painting for everyone, forever.
mechanism: An unbounded BigInt spigot streams the exact decimal digits of π client-side; each digit's parity fills or clears a square in a grid extended infinitely on scroll — deterministic, identical in every browser, no network.
references: François Morellet, Répartition aléatoire de 40 000 carrés suivant les chiffres pairs et impairs d'un annuaire de téléphone (1960)
